title: Slice 550732: Keep routing descriptions when vendor changes
summary: When the vendor changes on a subcontracting requisition line, Description and Description 2 are now kept from the matching production order routing line. The work-center descriptions are still used when the routing line is missing, belongs to another work center, or has a blank Description 2.
key_points: Description and Description 2 fields are retained from matching production order routing lines instead of refreshing from the work center
Work-center fallback is preserved when routing line is missing, belongs to another work center, or has blank Description 2
Fix applied to both IT BaseApp and W1 BaseApp layers
Includes regression test scenario to prevent regression
Addresses vendor validation issue in subcontracting workflow
quote: preserve subcontracting requisition Description and Description 2 from the matching production order routing line when the vendor changes
